spans.s: पुट् (I) vt. 6U (pres. पुटति) To embrace, to clasp, to intertwine.
पुट् (II) vt. 10U (pres. पुटयति-ते) 1. To be in contact with; 2. to bind together.
पुट् (III) vt. or vi. 10U (pres. पोटयति-ते) 1. To reduce to powder; 2. to shine; 3. to speak.

पुट (I) m.n. 1. A pocket; 2. a cup made of a leaf folded or doubled, R.ii.65; 3. a cavity, a concavity, e.g. अंजलिपुट; 4. the pod which envelops a young shoot, भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वनानिलः R.ix.68; 5. a cover, a covering; 6. an eyelid; 7. a horse’s hoof.
पुट-ग्रीव m. 1. a jar, a pitcher; 2. a copper vessel.
पुट-पाक m. a method of preparing drugs; in it the various ingredients are wrapped up in leaves covered with clay and baked in fire, पुटपाकप्रतीकाशो रामस्य करुणो रसः Ut.iii.
पुट-भेद m. 1. an eddy in a river; 2. a city, a town; 3. a kind of musical instrument.
पुट-भेदन n. a town, a city.
पुटक n. 1. Any shallow cup or concavity; 2. a vessel made of a leaf; 3. a lotus; 4. nutmeg.
पुटकिनी f. 1. A lotus; 2. a group of lotuses.
पुटित a. (f. ता) 1. Rubbed, ground; 2. contracted; 3. stitched.
पुटित a. (f. ता) 1. Rubbed, ground; 2. contracted; 3. stitched.
पुटी f. See the first six senses of पुट I, Sant.S.iv.10.
